name: Wrath++ native
description: What Wrath++'s interface can't do in the stock 32-bit client: the creator's choices per customization (WrathPP_Get/SetCustomization), who is made (GetCreating), the outfit (SetGear), the log (WrathPP_Log), the screen for the app's touch (SetScreen), the body options' layer on bare legs (a GeosRenderPrep detour), the parts a character wears (SetOverlay, ApplyLook) a woman's soft body (SetSoftBody: breast bone springs) and creatures' skins composed (an Init detour).
